description: Secrets manifest — defines what each agent needs and what API accounts are required

anthropic.notes: Required for Claude-driven autoresearch and any headless ClaudePY runtime. Local Claude Code OAuth is not enough for the H100 or unattended agent runs.

meta.notes: System user or user access token for Meta Marketing API. META_APP_SECRET is optional hardening for future appsecret_proof support, but the current ad-engine runtime only requires META_ACCESS_TOKEN.

canva.notes: Create a Canva Connect integration in the Developer Portal. Canva currently requires MFA before integration creation. Save the Client ID, generate a Client Secret, complete OAuth to get a refresh token, and store all three. Optional CANVA_ACCESS_TOKEN can be used for short-lived manual testing.

figma.notes: Personal access token from Figma > Settings > Account > Personal access tokens.

google_stitch.notes: Uses gcloud auth. Enable Vertex AI API in the target GCP project and make sure non-interactive auth works (gcloud auth login and, for local development, gcloud auth application-default login). No separate API key is required when gcloud can mint access tokens.

openrouter.notes: Optional for multimodal judging and model bakeoffs such as qwen/qwen3.6-plus:free. Even free-tier models still require an OpenRouter API key.

elevenlabs.notes: NEEDS ROTATION — old key was in git history.

slack.setup_url: Already configured in GCP Secret Manager

github.notes: PAT already exists but embedded in git remote URL. Should be moved to secrets.
